t: You're on Garlick Hill, a street in the City of London. Alice Hilliard, an English gentlewoman, died here. She was born in 1556, and the records give her death as 1611, though one note says she may have died before 1608, so the date isn't certain. Either way, she lived in the time of Elizabeth the First and James the First. The material doesn't tell us more about her, so that's what we know.
